listing.name: Tweaked Transverse Jump
listing.summary: Modifies Transverse Jump to no longer disable other abilities and adds planet identification for gravity wells.
listing.aiSummary: Modifies Transverse Jump to no longer disable other abilities and adds planet identification for gravity wells.

description:
Description:

Transverse Jump will no longer disable other abilities when activated; Sustained Burn most notably. A message will also be shown telling you what planet a gravity well belongs to when you stop in it and you will be prompted to turn on your transponder if jumping into non-hostile space.
